Title: What are appreciation tokens?
Answer: Tokens are a thank-you awarded for great work, milestones and recognition moments. You spend them in this store on company merchandise. They have no cash value.

Title: How do I earn tokens?
Answer: Admins and managers award tokens, for example for peer recognition, project milestones and work anniversaries. Each award shows in My wallet with the reason.

Title: Do my tokens expire?
Answer: No. Tokens stay in your wallet until you spend them.

Title: How do I collect my order?
Answer: Each order is booked onto the next collection day. Your confirmation email and My orders show the date, time, place and your pickup QR code. You also get a reminder the day before. Show the QR code at the desk.

Title: Can I cancel an order?
Answer: Yes, while it is still Pending. Open My orders and choose Cancel; your tokens are refunded straight away. After that, contact an admin.

Title: Can I transfer tokens to a colleague?
Answer: Not at the moment. To recognise a colleague, ask your manager or an admin to award them tokens.

Title: Who do I contact for help?
Answer: Contact the HR / People team or any store admin.
